02928 Telem {teh'-lem}

字根已不使用 意為"打破或暴力以對"; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Telem 2; 2

提鍊 = "壓迫"
專有名詞 人名
1) 在以斯拉時代, 被擄歸回者之中的看門人
專有名詞 地名
2) 在猶大南地的城市之一
record.edic_text:
02928 Telem {teh'-lem}

from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently;; n pr m

AV - Telem 2; 2

Telem = "oppression"
1) a gatekeeper among the returning exiles in the time of Ezra
n pr loc
2) one of the cities in the extreme south of Judah in the Negeb
